# call

abstract suspend fun [call](call.html)(context: [CallbackContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-callback-context/index.html)): [CallbackChoice](../-callback-choice/index.html)<[EventActions](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/index.html), [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html)>

Callback executed before an agent's primary logic is invoked.

This callback can be used for logging, setup, or short-circuiting the agent's execution.

#### Return

A [CallbackChoice](../-callback-choice/index.html) where returning [CallbackChoice.Break](../-callback-choice/-break/index.html) with custom [Content](../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html) bypasses the agent's regular execution entirely and directly yields the provided content. Returning [CallbackChoice.Continue](../-callback-choice/-continue/index.html) with [EventActions](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/index.html) allows normal execution to proceed, merging any actions into the running context.

#### Parameters

 _context_

The context of the current agent call.
